name: When should I consider replacing my countertops?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your countertops when they show significant wear such as deep scratches, cracks, stains that won't lift, or if they are outdated and no longer fit your aesthetic. Beyond cosmetic issues, replacement might be necessary if your countertops are harboring bacteria due to damage or if you're undertaking a larger kitchen or bathroom remodel. Frasheski Construction can assess the condition of your existing countertops during an initial consultation to help you determine if replacement is the most suitable option for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacing countertops when they show significant wear, damage, or are outdated. It's often part of a larger remodel or when existing surfaces harbor bacteria.
